milestones.title: Foundations: mission control and product definition
Phase 0: weighed Brazilian benchmark, evaluation engine and baselines
Phase 1: on-device PWA MVP on the owner iPhone 16e passing the phase-1 accuracy gate

acceptance.criterion: Every gate passes on a known-good fixture and is proven to fail on at least one broken fixture
Claude Code hooks: silent when macrofy is untouched, block turn end on gate failure or missing handoff, release when stuck, re-inject the brief after compaction
The live Macrofy control state and documentation pass every fast gate

tasks.title: Define Macrofy's mission, goals, non-goals and first product milestone with the owner

acceptance.criterion: The owner approved control/mission.json (status approved) and ADR 0002 (Status: Accepted), including the open platform and data-collection decisions
A product milestone exists whose tasks cover every product goal, each with check-backed acceptance criteria

tasks.title: Benchmark tooling: meal manifest schema, capture protocol, validator with frozen test split and leakage rules

acceptance.criterion: Validator rejects leakage (same meal or near-duplicate photo across splits; splits by capture date), unhashed test-set changes and malformed weights, each proven by a negative fixture

tasks.title: Evaluation engine: per-sample MAPE, signed bias, within-±10/20/30%, Bland-Altman, interval coverage, cluster-bootstrap 95% CI

acceptance.criterion: Every metric matches hand-computed values on synthetic fixtures, and the CI procedure bootstraps by capture day

tasks.title: Food vocabulary and nutrient mapping v0 from free sources (TACO + FNDDS; recipes computed from ingredients with Brazilian default oil), with state, method and default-oil facets and FNDDS-derived densities

acceptance.criterion: Every class resolves to a nutrient entry, has all three facets and a density; licenses of every bundled source are recorded

tasks.title: Owner collects 300 weighed meals (150 calibration, 150 locked test) following the capture protocol, split by capture date

acceptance.criterion: Benchmark has >=300 meals captured over >=8 weeks with per-item weights, varied plates/lighting/angles as the protocol requires, and passes the validator
Owner confirms the weighing protocol was followed

tasks.title: Experiment: metric scale error from a registered plate (known diameter, rim ellipse fit) on the iPhone 16e at 25-40 cm

acceptance.criterion: Written result with scale error distribution on >=30 captures of objects of known size on the owner iPhone 16e, reviewed independently

tasks.title: On-device PWA MVP on the iPhone 16e (segment, name, depth, plate scale, volume, density, nutrients, one-tap confirm, conformal ranges) passes the phase-1 gate

acceptance.criterion: On at least 30 scale-checked meals: upper 95% CI of meal kcal MAPE <=30%, item mass MAPE <=35%, |bias| <=10%, 80% ranges cover 75-85%
On the owner iPhone 16e in Safari with no network after first load: result in <=2 s and <=1 confirmation tap for a typical plate

tasks.title: Request a TBCA commercial license from USP/FoRC (draft by agent, sent by owner); fall back to free sources if refused

acceptance.criterion: Request sent and the reply (grant, terms, or refusal) recorded as a journal note; if refused or unanswered after 30 days, T-005 free-source mapping is the recorded decision

tasks.title: Measure zero-training food naming (SigLIP 2 zero-shot + k-NN gallery from calibration photos) on Brazilian dishes

acceptance.criterion: Top-1 and top-3 naming accuracy reported on held-out owner photos with no gallery leakage; result recorded as go / no-go against a 85% top-3 bar

tasks.title: Capture PWA: guided photo capture, plate registry, per-item weight entry, export in the benchmark manifest format

acceptance.criterion: A generated sample export passes the benchmark validator
Owner captures and exports one real weighed meal end to end on the iPhone 16e

tasks.title: Feasibility: load and run Depth Anything V2-Small, SAM 2.1-tiny and SigLIP 2 in Safari on the iPhone 16e (WebGPU/WASM)

acceptance.criterion: Owner runs the hosted feasibility page (GitHub Pages) on the iPhone 16e; for each model it records which candidate loaded, backend (WebGPU/WASM), download size, first and cached load time, median inference latency, and whether the tab survived; go/no-go against <=2 s total inference
Feasibility page files, pinned CDN version and verdict logic pass the web selftest

tasks.title: Estimation prototype in the PWA: tap-to-outline (SAM), top-3 naming (SigLIP) over the vocab, plate-rim ellipse scale from a registered plate, grams = area x class thickness prior x solid-aware density, oil question, macros via nutrition lookup, uncalibrated ranges, predictions export

acceptance.criterion: The pure estimation core (ellipse scale, area to volume to grams with solid-aware density, nutrients, ranges, predictions export) matches hand-computed fixtures, and its predictions export is accepted by the eval engine
Owner runs it on the iPhone 16e on one real plate end to end: items outlined and named, grams and macros shown with ranges, labelled uncalibrated

tasks.title: Automatic mode (ADR 0005): SAM2.1 point-grid masks, ellipse-fit plate selection, food/non-food filter with SigLIP, auto naming, one prefilled confirmation screen; tap mode kept for corrections

acceptance.criterion: Pure mask post-processing (grid prompts, IoU dedupe, plate selection by ellipse residual, area filters, overlap resolution, same-label fragment merge, non-food rejection) matches fixtures on synthetic scenes
On 10 real plates on the owner iPhone 16e, auto mode finds the plate in >=9 and >=80% of items with zero taps; per-photo time recorded

tasks.title: Fit segmentation and naming in Safari on the iPhone 16e: per-backend crash resume, vision-only naming with text embeddings precomputed in CI, storage/quota diagnostics, lighter candidates

acceptance.criterion: Selftests prove every (model, backend, dtype) is attempted once and a crash skips only that attempt; the naming stage loads only a vision encoder and scores against a committed text-embedding file whose provenance (model id, revision, labels hash) is checked against the vocab
Owner re-runs the feasibility page on the iPhone 16e: segmentation (SAM on some backend, or a documented no-SAM fallback) and naming both load, combined inference recorded; go/no-go against <=2 s

tasks.title: Zero setup + scale checks (ADR 0006): no plate registration or ruler anywhere in the default flow (typical-plate prior); "Conferir com balança" after an estimate stores truth grams (and an optional other-app kcal for comparison); learned per-user correction and conformal ranges from checks; accuracy screen with 95% CI via the eval engine

acceptance.criterion: Pure calibration core: correction factor and conformal quantiles learned from scale-check fixtures match hand-computed values; with zero checks the typical-plate prior and its wider ranges apply; the checks export is scored by the eval engine
Headless smoke: photo -> result with no plate registration and no required taps; the scale-check entry updates the correction
Owner uses it on the iPhone 16e: points the camera, gets a result with no setup, and records at least one scale check
